harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured 802.1Q VLAN trunking over the shared physical link (node1 eth1, node2/node3 enp8s0). node1 (OpenWrt) hosts eth1.10 (10.10.10.1/24) and eth1.20 (10.10.20.1/24) as router for both VLANs, plus firewall zones 'vlan10' and 'vlan20' (input/output ACCEPT, forward REJECT, no forwarding rule between them). node2 (Ubuntu, systemd-networkd) has vlan10 sub-interface on enp8s0 at 10.10.10.2/24; node3 has vlan20 sub-interface on enp8s0 at 10.10.20.2/24. Verified each host reaches node1 on its own VLAN, cross-VLAN pings fail naturally (no route) and are explicitly REJECTed by node1's firewall when routed. Completed mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on node1, node2, node3: captured pre-restart boot_id/uptime, issued native reboot (systemctl reboot / busybox reboot) backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect, polled until exec access returned, confirmed changed boot_id each time, and re-verified VLAN config, IP addresses, firewall rules, and both reachability/isolation behavior post-reboot on every node.
actions_performed: Inspected baseline topology/IPs on node1 (OpenWrt), node2, node3 (Ubuntu 24.04) and identified eth1/enp8s0 as the shared physical link
Configured OpenWrt UCI 8021q devices eth1.10 (vid10) and eth1.20 (vid20) with static IPs 10.10.10.1/24 and 10.10.20.1/24, committed network, restarted network service
Added firewall zones vlan10 and vlan20 on node1 with input/output ACCEPT, forward REJECT, no forwarding rule between them; committed and reloaded firewall
Created systemd-networkd .netdev/.network files on node2 for vlan10 (10.10.10.2/24) bound to enp8s0, without a conflicting default gateway
Created systemd-networkd .netdev/.network files on node3 for vlan20 (10.10.20.2/24) bound to enp8s0, without a conflicting default gateway
Verified node2/node3 can each reach node1 on their own VLAN, and cannot reach each other (no route + explicit firewall REJECT test)
Captured pre-restart boot_id/uptime baseline on all three nodes
Rebooted node1, polled until exec returned, confirmed new boot_id, re-verified VLAN interfaces, firewall config, and connectivity to both node2 and node3
Rebooted node2, polled until exec returned, confirmed new boot_id and fresh uptime, re-verified vlan10 config, reachability to node1, and isolation from node3
Rebooted node3, polled until exec returned, confirmed new boot_id and fresh uptime, re-verified vlan20 config, reachability to node1, and isolation from node2
Final cross-check: node1 pings both node2 and node3 successfully post-restart

evidence.requirement: VLAN 10/20 tagged trunk configured on shared link with node1 as router for both subnets
evidence.summary: node1 eth1 (shared link) carries eth1.10 (10.10.10.1/24) and eth1.20 (10.10.20.1/24) as router interfaces for VLAN10/VLAN20

evidence.requirement: node2 placed in VLAN10 with its own subnet, reaches node1
evidence.summary: node2 vlan10 sub-interface on enp8s0 gets 10.10.10.2/24 and successfully pings node1 at 10.10.10.1

evidence.requirement: node3 placed in VLAN20 with its own subnet, reaches node1
evidence.summary: node3 vlan20 sub-interface on enp8s0 gets 10.10.20.2/24 and successfully pings node1 at 10.10.20.1

evidence.requirement: traffic between node2 and node3 (different VLANs) is refused
evidence.summary: node2->node3 and node3->node2 pings fail with no route by default; when explicitly routed via node1, firewall REJECTs (Destination Port Unreachable) confirming active isolation, not just missing routes

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id c1b0817e...; issued backgrounded reboot with ack returned; connection dropped confirming disruption; polled until exec returned with new boot_id 76767044... and uptime ~12s; re-verified VLAN IPs, firewall zones, and bidirectional pings to node2/node3 all recovered

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 1e0cb179...; reboot ack returned before disconnect; connection timed out confirming disruption; new boot_id 63f1d89c... with uptime ~8s confirms restart; vlan10 config, reachability to node1, and isolation from node3 all recovered

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id c96a02ae...; reboot ack returned before disconnect; connection timed out confirming disruption; new boot_id a5127a39... with uptime ~7s confirms restart; vlan20 config, reachability to node1, and isolation from node2 all recovered
